units.source_text: 古歌：“特地钟情汝，专心誓不移。

en.t: An old poem says: I have set my heart especially on you, and with all my heart I swear it will never change.

units.source_text: 相思字太泛，另外觅新词。”

en.t: The words mutual longing are too vague, so I will seek some new expression instead.
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu Rokucho.
